text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look back on what Seeking the Pearl
has
achieved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her victories in the Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies, the
Oka Sho, and the NHK Mile
Championship were
all within our
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after developing epiglottic
entrapment, she
remained undefeatable
in the mile. However...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: This is unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't steal my line!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But it really is so wonderful! After
running in the
NHK Mile Championship...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You went on to win the Mile
Championship, the
Victoria Mile, and
the Yasuda Kinen. And on top
of that...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
You won the Mile Championship again
for
consecutive victories! I can't believe
you've won
so many G1 races!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I suppose you have a point. It all
happened
before I even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Um! I hardly think this is the case, but
the news
about you having epiglottic
entrapment...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Those reports weren't fabricated, were
they? Or
are you completely healed
now?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course not. This condition is a badge
of honor
that makes me stronger. And...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know the reason I was able to keep
winning so
many mile races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't even know the reason myself, but

apparently Seeking the Pearl does.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yep. It's because...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten so strong that even my
condition isn't
enough to hinder me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm best at sprints, I can still win
miles if
I'm astoundingly fast enough!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm a brilliant pearl now!
Tiny
scratches upon my facade mean
nothing to me!
Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all becomes clear when she explains
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her condition may have held her back,
but she
compensated for those limits
and even exceeded
them with her own
strength and willpower.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And after achieving such a great feat, I
believe I
deserve a fitting reward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. There's something I want you to
prepare
for me. As for what it is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! This is it! My very own room
to relax
in! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The regular break room just doesn't cut
it. I need
to relax in gorgeous luxury!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl seems satisfied with
the room I
arranged for her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And in a room as magnificent as this, I
expect it
to be fully fitted with an air
conditioner or three...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh? What's this?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You borrowed something, did you?
Wait, could it
be?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: An electric fan!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why, this is even more fabulous than an
air
conditioner! I can even do that one
silly little
thing everyone loves to do!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You know what I'm talking about? Then
allow me
to give you a legendary
performance to enjoy! All
I must do is
stand in front of the fan and...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ofofofo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She happily recreates the alien laugh she
had
before. Well, this is her own room,
so she can do
whatever she wants.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This room is amazing, Trainer. If only I
could stay
in a room like this while
abroad...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You know, I might just be able to make
another
miracle happen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm talking about winning a G1 mile
overseas. And
I mean a really huge race.
choice_data_list: もうひとつの？それって……？

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Something different from the Prix
Jacques Le
Marois that Taiki won.
Preferably something no
one would
expect me to win...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why, I might be able to claim victory in
it, come
deep turf or heavy rains.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How nice it is to imagine an
ever-changing
future...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And it's thanks to you that I have the
power to
change everything now.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, listen to me, saying all this
nonsense and
blabbing nonstop!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a pre-celebration. Let's enjoy this

glamorous time together while imagining
all our
future glory! ♪ Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We clink our carbonated drinks
together. If I
listen closely...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can hear the current of the
Seine,
along with the enthusiastic cheers
echoing in our
future.
